verdict.rationale: Pilot's bookkeeping service implies production of standard financial statements (real-time account data, custom reporting, AI answers about cash flow, budget vs actuals) but no evidence explicitly confirms on-demand generation of a full P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any arbitrary period. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the three core statements, confirmation of 'any period' selection/on-demand generation, and independent user confirmation of statement accuracy.
